/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.description: The Leg Press Double gives two people a seated leg press each, on one frame finished in lavender with orange seats. Users sit back, place their feet on the plates and push them away, working the thighs, hips and calves against their own weight. The lavender frame stands apart from the orange and grey machines in our Fun Fitness range, which helps if you want the gym corner to match a society's colour scheme. A double unit is useful on walking tracks where people arrive in pairs. Sales can share the exact size and warranty cover on request. Our standard cover is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and the Leg Press Double warranty will be confirmed in your quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.spec_paragraph: Each seat moves on a pivoting arm, so there are two sets of bearings to inspect and grease. On a double machine, uneven ground puts the frame under twist, so we grout it on soft soil and only use self-standing fixing on a firm, level base. Keep the space in front of both footplates clear.

The user leans back, pushes the plates forward until the legs are nearly straight and lets them return slowly. It strengthens the large leg muscles that help with walking, climbing stairs and getting up from a chair, so it suits older residents as well as younger users. One-seat machines are easy to place in a small society garden or along a jogging track. It is finished in Play Orange. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. Under our standard terms, galvanised pipes are covered for 3 years and bearings for 1 year, which we will confirm in writing. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.spec_paragraph: On the single Leg Press, the seat arm and its pivot carry most of the load, so these are the first parts to check during maintenance. It can go in self-standing on a firm slab or be grouted into soil. Keep the seat out of direct puddles by placing it on slightly raised ground.

Stronger users do dips, lifting and lowering the body between the bars. Others use the bars for supported leg raises, push-ups at an angle or simply to hold while stretching. With no moving parts, it is one of the easiest machines to look after in a park, college or society gym. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. The product listing for this item has no subtitle, image description, dimensions or warranty line. We will confirm the Parallel Bar Double's warranty with your quote; our standard term for galvanised pipes is 3 years. Ask us to add it to your plan.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/paralle.spec_paragraph: Dips put a user's full weight on the bars, so the central post is best grouted into a solid base. Lay rubber flooring under both sides where users step down. Maintenance is simple: check the bolts where the bars meet the post, and look for chipped coating that could let rust start.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/paralle.description: The Parallel Bar is a single station in Ocean Grey: one post with a pair of angled bars that a user grips on either side of the body. The main exercise is the dip, where the user lowers and raises the body to work the arms, chest and shoulders. Less experienced users can keep their feet on the ground and use the bars for support during squats or stretches. It has no moving parts, which keeps upkeep low. The Parallel Bar fits a small corner of a society gym or a school ground. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our sales team will confirm the cover; standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes. Ask us for a layout drawing.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/pendulu.description: The Pendulum Double gives two people a swinging step each. Users stand on the orange footplate, hold the handlebar and swing both legs together from side to side like a pendulum. The movement loosens the hips, waist and lower back and gives a light workout for the core. It is easy to learn, so walkers in a park or residents in a society can use it without instruction. With two stations on one frame, it handles a busy morning crowd. It comes in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. For the Pendulum Double, our standard cover would be 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, confirmed in your quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/pendulu.spec_paragraph: Each footplate hangs from a bearing at the top of its arm, and these bearings need regular greasing. We install the Pendulum Double self-standing or grouted. Leave space on both sides of each station, because the step swings outward, and keep walkers from cutting between the two users.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/pendulu.description: Our single Pendulum is a one-person swing step with an orange footplate. It is a gentle mobility exercise for the waist and hips that many older users like after a walk. Because it takes up little space, a single Pendulum suits a terrace garden, a hospital campus or the edge of a jogging track. It is finished in Play Orange. Send us your site photos for a layout.

Users hang from the top bar and pull the chin up to it, or support themselves on the lower bars and lower and raise the body. It is aimed at stronger users such as college students, police and security staff, and sports teams, and it gives a park gym a strength corner. Beginners can still hang from the bar or do assisted pull-ups with their feet on the ground. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Its height and footprint have not been listed yet. We will confirm the Pull Up Station warranty with your quote; our standard term for galvanised pipes is 3 years.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/pull-up.spec_paragraph: Hanging and dropping are part of every pull-up, so lay rubber flooring under the whole station. The frame is normally grouted, because users load it with their full weight. There are no moving parts, so maintenance is mainly checking welds and bolts and keeping the bar grip clean.

On the tai chi side, the user stands and turns two spinner wheels with the hands, working the shoulders and arms. Both movements are slow and controlled, which makes this a good choice for a senior citizens' corner or a society garden where older residents gather. It comes in Play Orange and is part of our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. For the Seating Twister Cum Tai Chi, standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in your quote.

This combination goes in self-standing or grouted. Position it so the standing user at the wheels has room behind them, and keep the seat dry.
